A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same SAMBLE paper with 25 complete, readable pages, including supplementary Sections 6–16. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that the differences are confined to the version stamp and Figure 9.

before.justification: v1 reports original SAMBLE experiments on ModelNet40 classification and ShapeNet-Part segmentation, including few-point sampling, ablations and runtime measurements.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and their numerical results, including the classification and segmentation outcomes in Table 2.

M1.justification: The sparse attention maps, sampling scores, adaptive bin boundaries, bin tokens and sampling procedure are unchanged, including the supplementary variants and Algorithm 1.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same ModelNet40 and ShapeNet-Part coverage, downstream tasks and few-point scenarios. Figure 9 retains the same shapes and sampling sizes.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout the tables and qualitative comparisons, including APES variants, PointNeXt and the other sampling baselines. Figure 9 still compares APES with SAMBLE.

E3.justification: Dataset splits, preprocessing, metrics, point counts, training settings and runtime evaluation procedures are unchanged. The Figure 9 correction does not document a changed experimental protocol.

E4.justification: The same ablations, sensitivity studies, efficiency analysis and qualitative examples are retained. Figure 9 rearranges existing panels to correct attribution; it introduces no new analytical test or case.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged throughout the main text and supplement. Neither version provides repeated-run uncertainty estimates, confidence intervals or significance tests for the benchmark scores.

E6.justification: For the lower chair example in Figure 9, v1 attributes broadly distributed samples to APES and concentrated samples to SAMBLE; v2 reverses these assignments by exchanging the image rows. This corrects a qualitative result attribution. All numerical results remain unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, Equations 1–10 and supplementary reasoning about gradients and softmax are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, contributions and conclusion retain the same claims about shape-specific sampling, balancing local detail with global uniformity, and downstream performance.

C2.justification: Interpretations of sampling behavior, bin mechanisms, upsampling limitations and efficiency trade-offs are unchanged. Figure 9 now supports the existing interpretation without revising its wording or scope.

D1.justification: The supplementary pseudocode, architecture descriptions, optimizer settings, training budgets and RTX 3090 timing setup are identical. Code and data access information is unchanged.

R1.justification: Related-work discussions and the 62-reference bibliography are unchanged, including the positioning relative to APES and other learning-based sampling methods.

P1.justification: The margin stamp changes from v1 dated 28 April 2025 to v2 dated 30 May 2025. The paper's prose, headings and section organization are otherwise identical.

P2.justification: Figure 9 exchanges the lower chair's heatmap and sampled-point panels between the fixed APES and SAMBLE labels. Its caption and sampling-size headings remain unchanged; other figures, tables and page layouts are retained.

improvement.justification: The Figure 9 correction removes a misleading method attribution and makes the lower chair comparison consistent with Section 4.3 and the sampling patterns illustrated in supplementary Figure 26. This is a localized improvement in clarity and internal consistency; the methods and quantitative evidence remain unchanged.
